established_facts_used.how_used: This establishes that the threat has escalated beyond uniformed police to the Agents, meaning the escape sequence must convey Trinity evading not just officers but a pursuit led by entities with superior speed and coordination — and the Agents' arrival at the end of the escape must reflect their direct involvement in the chase, not merely arriving after the fact

established_facts_used.fact: The Agents are presented with insectoid uniformity and non-human precision, seeming omnipotent
established_facts_used.how_used: The ending beat — Agents finding the phone off the hook — must play against this established omnipotence to introduce the first crack: their precision failed to prevent the exit. The contrast between their established capability and this failure is what makes the moment land

established_facts_used.fact: The Heart O' The City Hotel is a decaying, abandoned-feeling location with compromised structural integrity
established_facts_used.how_used: The environment provides the physical geometry of the escape — corridors, stairwells, fire exits, the specific room number 303 — and its decayed state means doors don't lock properly, walls have gaps, the building offers unconventional paths a person being hunted might exploit

constraints_honoured: The scene must complete the cold open and transition toward Neo's ordinary world, meaning it must end on a definitive narrative beat (Agents' reaction to the empty phone) rather than continuing the chase indefinitely
Trinity's escape must feel narrow and costly, not triumphant — the scene's emotional register is desperation and survival by fractions of a second, not empowerment

The Agents' frustration must be expressed as a flicker in performance and behavior, not dialogue — no monologue explaining their feelings, no humanizing speech; their reaction must be read through physicality and micro-expressions
No dialogue beyond minimal tactical communication — the scene is primarily visual and kinetic, with any spoken words limited to short tactical commands or warnings that serve the action

The hardline exit must be staged with sufficient visual clarity that the audience understands Trinity left through the phone (was extracted) rather than being killed, teleporting arbitrarily, or disappearing by magic — the phone is the mechanism, and its use must be legible

The Agents must not be depicted as incompetent — they arrive nearly in time, they are fast and coordinated, and the implication is that Trinity succeeded by a margin so thin it could not be repeated; their frustration stems from the margin, not from error
The scene's compression at roughly 157 words means every beat must do double duty — action and characterization must be simultaneous, with no wasted motion in the prose

contradictions_checked.risk: Depicting Trinity's escape as too clean or easy, which would contradict the established threat level of the Agents and make the two prior scenes of setup feel hollow
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: Staging the escape as a series of barely-successful evasions where each obstacle is cleared by a shrinking margin — she is hit, grazed, forced through walls rather than around them, and the phone begins ringing with seconds to spare. The Agents are physically present in the corridor before the handset is lifted. The audience must feel that a half-second's difference would have ended differently.

contradictions_checked.risk: Depicting the hardline exit as arbitrary magic rather than an established mechanism, confusing the audience about what happened
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: The phone is shown ringing before Trinity reaches it — it is an expected extraction point, not a deus ex machina. The visual of her reaching for the handset, the line going dead, and the Agents finding the off-hook receiver provides a causal chain the audience can follow: the phone was the exit, she used it, she is gone. The mechanism's rules are implied by its presentation.

contradictions_checked.risk: Humanizing the Agents too early through their frustration, contradicting the established insectoid non-human precision from sc-002
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: The Agents' frustration is expressed through a single physical tell — a momentary stillness, a jaw tightening, a gaze lingering on the phone — rather than through dialogue or extended emotional display. They remain otherwise motionless and uniform. The tell is a crack in the facade, not a removal of it. The audience reads it because they have been watching these entities for two scenes and a deviation of any size registers.

contradictions_checked.risk: Creating tonal whiplash by ending the cold open on a note that doesn't carry unease into the transition to Neo's world
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: Ending on the Agents' reaction rather than on Trinity's escape — the audience's last image is not a triumphant exit but the unsettling realization that the pursuers are still there, still capable, and now informed. The unease the audience carries forward is not 'the hero escaped' but 'the hunters are learning.' This mood — ordinary life under invisible surveillance — is the bridge to Neo's mundane reality.

contradictions_checked.risk: Depicting superhuman speed and precision in a way that reads as a different genre (superhero film) rather than the established tone of grounded dread
contradictions_checked.avoided_by: Framing Trinity's capabilities not as powers but as trained responses operating at the edge of human possibility — the speed comes from knowing exactly what to do and having rehearsed it, not from supernatural ability. The camera (prose) observes her with the same clinical detachment the Agents use, so the audience sees the technique rather than the spectacle. Physical consequences (bleeding, breathing, shaking hands) ground the action in the body.

state_preconditions.must_be: Room 303, Heart O' The City Hotel, inside the Matrix, at gunpoint
hunting_trinity — Agents have asserted authority over the police operation and are actively pursuing
escape_point — the hotel contains a hardline that the resistance has designated as an extraction route, unknown to the Agents until this scene
unknown — the Agents have not yet witnessed a hardline extraction in progress; they may suspect or theorize about resistance escape methods but have not confirmed this specific mechanism

forward_commitments: The story must now transition to Neo's mundane reality, and the unease established by this scene — the sense of invisible surveillance and of a world where people vanish through phones — must carry forward as subtext in scenes that appear ordinary on the surface

The Agents have now confirmed that resistance operatives exit through hardlines; later scenes must reflect that they are actively working to identify and shut down these exits, raising the stakes for any future extraction

The Heart O' The City Hotel hardline is compromised — its address is now in the Agents' awareness — and any later scene that attempts to use this location for extraction must acknowledge that it is no longer safe

Trinity's physical state post-extraction (injuries sustained during the escape) must be consistent if she appears in the real world subsequently — she was not unharmed, and the real-world body bears the Matrix-session's accumulated stress

The audience's understanding of the phone-as-exit mechanism, established visually in this scene, becomes the basis for later scenes where hardlines are used, threatened, or destroyed — the rules implied here must remain consistent

The Agents' frustration, first shown here, must develop along the trajectory established by their character — it is the seed of Smith's later obsession, but that development must not be rushed; this scene plants the crack, later scenes widen it
